column1: Why I built Planlete. Pen and paper round the gym, a different sheet for every workout, print-outs, screenshots on my phone, and progressive overload that was impossible to track. So I built an app, custom made for me, with exercises I didn't know would help. Now it's yours too. planlete.co.uk
